rows.text: Replying in the Lok Sabha on 6 March 1991 (English translation of a Hindi speech), the Prime Minister, Shri Chandra Shekhar, says his Government is going to resign and that he will call on the President to tender his resignation, and asks for the House to be adjourned; the Speaker, 'in view of the resignation announced by the Prime Minister on the floor of the House', treats the Motion of Thanks as infructuous and adjourns the House at 14.00 hrs until 11.00 on 7 March.

locator.item: Re. Constitutional Crisis in the Country (cols 787-814); reply by Shri Chandra Shekhar from col 804 (PDF p.405, '[Translation] SHRI CHANDRA SHEKHAR:') to col 814 (PDF p.410); Speaker's ruling and adjournment at 14.00 hrs to 11.00 on 7 March
